task_instance: Implement the skill's production-ready Apollo SDK pattern library: create the five TypeScript modules it specifies (client.ts Zod-validated singleton with x-api-key header, errors.ts with ApolloApiError/ApolloRateLimitError, retry.ts exponential backoff with jitter, paginator.ts async pagination generator, bulk-enrich.ts batch enrichment), compile them under TypeScript 5+ strict mode, and verify the core non-network logic at runtime.
evidence: Work dir contains package.json, tsconfig.json, [host-1].json, and src/apollo/{client,errors,retry,paginator,bulk-enrich}.ts transcribed faithfully from SKILL.md (placeholder base-URL replaced by an inert non-routable .invalid host since the real endpoint is a placeholder). Installed axios, zod, typescript, @types/node into local node_modules via npm (quiet, work-dir only; no global/sudo). Verified deliverable: (1) strict type-check `tsc -p tsconfig.json` exits 0 with zero errors across all five modules; (2) emitted JS and ran a runtime harness (build/verify.cjs) exercising the core logic without any network call to the SaaS provider -> RESULT 6 passed, 0 failed: Zod rejects a too-short API key, getApolloClient returns a singleton, the x-api-key header is set from first init, withRetry recovers after retryable 503s (3 calls), withRetry rethrows a non-retryable 401 immediately (1 call), and ApolloApiError.fromAxios flags a 429 as retryable with correct statusCode/endpoint. The skill's allowed-tools are only Read/Write/Edit and its deliverable is the code patterns themselves, not live API traffic, so no provider credentials, account, or connector were needed; the failed provider MCP connector was not used.
